title: Measuring the effect of drug treatments on primary human CD8+ T cell activation and cytolytic potential
protocol: Aliquot 12 mL Lymphoprep into 50 mL conical tubes.
Dilute whole blood using non-supplemented RPMI 1640 media in a sterile flask at roughly 1:1 ratio with non-supplemented RPMI 1640 media.
Mix well by pipetting up and down using a 25 mL serological pipette.
Rinse each tube containing whole blood with 10 mL of non-supplemented RPMI 1640 and add to the sterile flask.
Set the pipettor to its slowest dispense rate.
Carefully layer up to 36 mL of diluted whole blood onto Lymphoprep aliquots.
Place and balance the conical tubes in the centrifuge.
Centrifuge for 25 min at 600 g with zero or lowest acceleration and deceleration, at room temperature.
Set the centrifuge back to highest acceleration and deceleration, and 4°C temperature settings after centrifugation.
Aspirate and dispose of the plasma component (top layer) from the conical tube.
Slowly aspirate the buffy coat and place it in a clean 50 mL conical tube.
Top up the conical tubes containing pooled buffy coats with non-supplemented RPMI 1640 media.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Aspirate and discard supernatants.
Wash cell pellet by adding 40 mL of non-supplemented RPMI 1640 media and centrifuge at 300 g for 10 min, at 4°C.
Aspirate and discard supernatant.
Repeat washing step to remove Lymphoprep.
Prepare 10 mL of 1× Red Blood Cell (RBC) lysis solution from 10× stock by mixing 1 part of 10× RBC lysis solution in 9 parts of sterile water.
Resuspend each cell pellet slowly with 2 mL 1× RBC lysis solution.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Add 5 mL of MACS buffer to each tube and pool all cell suspensions into a singular 50 mL conical tube.
Top up to 50 mL with MACS buffer.
Count the number of cells and viability using ready-to-use trypan blue (0.4%) solution.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 10 min at 4°C and discard supernatant.
Proceed to CD8+ T cell magnetic labeling following manufacturer recommendations.
Centrifuge purified CD8+ T cells at 300 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Discard MACS buffer supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 2 mL of supplemented T cell culture media with IL-2.
Centrifuge the resuspended cells at 300 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend purified CD8+ T cells in 5 mL of supplemented T cell culture media with IL-2.
Count the number of cells and viability using a ready-to-use trypan blue (0.4%) solution.
Optional: Stain cells with 1:100 concentration of CD3, CD4, CD8 antibodies diluted in 100 μL FACS Buffer.
Incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells with FACS buffer and proceed to flow cytometry analysis.
Resuspend the total CD8+ T cells at a density of 200,000 cells per mL in supplemented T cell media with IL-2.
Transfer resuspended CD8+ T cells into a sterile reagent reservoir.
Using a multichannel pipette, transfer 50 μL of the resuspended CD8+ T cells to U-bottom 96-well plates designed for suspension cell culture.
Resuspend CD8+ T cells at 200,000 cells per mL.
Transfer 50 μL of CD8+ T cell suspension to each well of a U-bottom 96-well plate.
Calculate the number of Dynabeads needed based on the ratio of 1 bead to 2 T cells.
Centrifuge or use a magnet to wash Dynabeads in T cell culture media.
Resuspend Dynabeads at 100,000 beads per mL in supplemented T cell media with IL-2.
Transfer resuspended Dynabeads into a sterile reagent reservoir.
Add 50 μL of resuspended Dynabeads to each well containing CD8+ T cells.
Transfer 50 μL of Dynabeads to the T cells seeded in the U-bottom 96-well plates.
Seed 10,000 T cells per well prior to bead addition.
Prepare a working stock of the drug of choice.
Prepare a 2× working stock solution of drug treatments.
Transfer the drug of choice to a sterile reagent reservoir.
Add 100 μL of 2× working stock solution to appropriate wells.
For non-treatment wells, add 100 μL of supplemented T cell media with IL-2 and vehicle control.
Harvest CD8+ T cells by pooling each treatment condition into conical tubes using a multichannel pipette.
Spin cells at 200 g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Discard supernatant.
Place the microcentrifuge tube containing the pellet in the DynaMag2 magnet for 1 minute.
Resuspend the T cell pellet in 500 μL of supplemented T cell media with IL-2.
Transfer the resuspended cells into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube after removing magnetic beads using the DynaMag2 magnet.
Transfer suspension cells into a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube or 15 mL conical tube.
Count the number of cells and viability using ready-to-use trypan blue (0.4%) solution.
Resuspend T cells at 1×10^6 cells per mL in T cell media.
Stimulate CD8+ T cells with PMA/ionomycin for intracellular marker staining of functional cytokines TNF and IFNɣ.
Transfer 250 μL of media containing 250,000 T cells for each condition to a V-bottom 96-well plate, including controls.
Spin the plate at 200 g for 2 min to pellet the cells.
Remove 150 μL of media from each well.
Prepare a working 1:500 stock of Cocktail 1 and Cocktail 2, respectively.
Mix 2 μL of Cocktail 1 with 998 μL of T cell media to make a 1:1000 working stock of Cocktail 1.
Add 100 μL of the Cocktail 1 working stock to each corresponding well, bringing the final volume to 200 μL per well.
Mix 2 μL of Cocktail 2 with 998 μL of T cell media to make a 1:1000 working stock of Cocktail 2.
Add 100 μL of the Cocktail 2 working stock to each corresponding well, bringing the final volume to 200 μL per well.
Mix well components using a multichannel pipette.
Incubate at 37°C in a CO2 incubator for 4 h.
Spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min to pellet the cells and discard supernatant.
Wash cells with PBS, spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min and discard PBS.
Prepare 1:2000 dilution of cell viability dye in PBS.
Add 100 μL of cell viability dye to each well.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C, in the dark.
Add 100 μL of cold FACS buffer to each well.
Spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min to pellet the cells and discard supernatant.
Prepare 1× Fix Concentrate by mixing 1 part True-Nuclear Fix Concentrate with 3 parts Fix Diluent.
Add 100 μL of 1× Fix Concentrate to each well.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C, in the dark.
Wash each well with 200 μL of cold FACS buffer twice by spinning the plate at 200 g for 5 min to pellet the cells and discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 200 μL of cold FACS buffer and store plate at 4°C in the dark overnight (16–18 h).
Mix 1 part of True-Nuclear 10× Perm Buffer with 9 parts of distilled water to prepare 1× Perm Buffer.
Add 100 μL of 1× Perm Buffer to each well.
Spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min to pellet the cells, and discard supernatant.
Add 200 μL 1× Perm Buffer to wash the cells.
Spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min to pellet the cells, and discard supernatant.
Prepare antibodies for intracellular markers at a 1:50 dilution in 1× Perm Buffer.
Add 100 μL of antibodies cocktail diluted in 1× Perm Buffer to each well.
Incubate plate at 4°C for 30 min in the dark.
Add 100 μL of cold FACS buffer wash to each well, spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min to pellet the cells, and discard supernatant.
Prepare antibodies for CD8 or CD3 surface expression at a 1:100 dilution in FACS buffer.
Add 100 μL of antibodies cocktail to each well.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 100 μL of FACS buffer wash to each well.
Spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min to pellet the cells.
Discard supernatant.
Repeat step washing with FACS buffer.
Resuspend cells in FACS buffer.
Transfer cells to flow cytometry appropriate reading vials.
Place samples in the dark and at 4°C.
Acquire samples on the flow cytometer within 2 h of staining.
Spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min to pellet the cells.
Wash cells with 200 μL of FACS buffer in each well.
Spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min to pellet the cells and discard supernatant.
Prepare a 1:2000 dilution of cell viability dye in PBS.
Add 100 μL of diluted cell viability dye to each well.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 100 μL of FACS buffer to each well.
Spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min to pellet the cells and discard supernatant.
Prepare antibodies for cell surface markers at a 1:100 dilution in FACS buffer.
Add 100 μL of antibody cocktail to each well.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 200 μL of FACS buffer wash to each well.
Spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min to pellet the cells and discard supernatant.
Repeat previous washing step.
Resuspend cells in FACS buffer.
Transfer cells to flow cytometry appropriate reading vials.
Place cells on ice in the dark.
Acquire samples on the flow cytometer within 2 hours of staining.
Analyze cells as soon as possible following staining.
